incidents.title: Inky Dashboard partial outage

incidents.body:
On April 8ths, we noticed an issue with INKY partners where emails were failing to be sent or delivered, with a timeout error.  After some initial investigation, this turned out to only be affecting partners who were using INKY with Google Workspace.  There were no failures within the INKY product itself and the timeouts were specific to Google, who was experiencing an issue at that time.

‌

The RCA for this Google outage can be found here:  
  
[https://www.google.com/appsstatus/dashboard/incidents/224ozRqzW4sFBDK8hLnT](https://www.google.com/appsstatus/dashboard/incidents/224ozRqzW4sFBDK8hLnT)
incidents.title: INKY - Google Workspace partners - Emails fail to send or receive

incidents.body: On March 31s, our dev team observed that an email filter host was having a disproportionate amount of traffic sent to it, that was slowing down the response time.  This in turn caused additional pressure on some of our backend resources that were slowing down the email processing time.  This traffic did not cause the service to crash and auto scaling did not occur due to the CPU processing of the items not breaking a threshold.
incidents.title: Outbound mail delays in EU region

incidents.body: Microsoft reports that they have resolved the issue
incidents.title: Widespread Microsoft 365 Issue Potentially Impacting Email

incidents.body: Everything running smoothly as expected and has been have we monitored throughout the day.  Fixes now in place to correct issues tied to alerting and to prevent similar failures from occurring again.
incidents.title: Outbound Mail Delays

incidents.body: The backlog seems to have caught up, and Dashboard operations are back to normal.
